name: Takuhai Maid Shiiko-san
source:
Shiiko from Ikinari Happy Bell is dispatched for a week to the protagonist's house as special award from Terios fan club. She is perfect with home chores and is able to provide authentic maid experience.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《Ikinari Happy Bell》中的鹭之宫椎子作为Terios粉丝俱乐部的特别奖励，被派到主角家中服务一周。她精通所有家务，能够带来原汁原味的女仆体验。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
